blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein is topic ki heading “Types of Security Threads” chhapi hai. “Threads” (dhaage) ghalat hai; sahi lafz “Threats” (khatre) hai: “Types of Security Threats”.
Online services istemal karne mein security threats (khatron) ki paanch bari categories (qismein) hain: spam, spyware, cookies, phishing aur pharming. Har ek agle hisson mein alag samjhaya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt: Is hisse ke paanch security threats ke naam bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Spam, spyware, cookies, phishing aur pharming.

items: Paanch khatre: spam, spyware, cookies, phishing, pharming.
